verdict.rationale: Cactus is a local inference engine, so CPU+GPU offload is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents partial layer offload or running models larger than VRAM. Community reports point the other way: Needle 3 uses the Apple GPU only for training, not inference, and one user saw the GPU go unused on a Pixel even when enabled. Neither report documents an offload capability, and the vendored llama.cpp claim is not Cactus's own documented feature.
